title: Microstructural Characterization and Antibacterial Study of Ag Nanoparticles Synthesized by Aqueous Extract of Jatropha dioica
content: Nanotechnology uses science to manipulate matter at the molecular level, resulting in the production, use, and application of materials at the nanometer scale, such as nanoparticles [1]. Notably, silver nanoparticles (AgNPs) play an important role in health areas due to the increasing need to develop new antimicrobial agents to control pathogenic microorganisms. The shape, size, and composition of AgNPs significantly affect various medical applications, such as the coating of textile fabrics for clinical use, surgical instruments (catheters, prostheses, bandages), and dental treatment.
